name: InterContinental Resort Hua Hin
positioning: Seaside luxury resort, officially InterContinental Hua Hin Resort, blending Eastern and Western design on the Gulf of Thailand, with an infinity-edge pool overlooking the ocean, beachfront pool villas and a classic car museum
best_for: Travelers who want a beach and pool resort in Hua Hin
Couples or families who want a beachfront villa with a private pool
Guests who would enjoy a classic car exhibition and an art garden on site

facts.text: The resort is a seaside luxury resort blending Eastern and Western design, beside the waters of the gulf.
The resort has two accommodation wings with spacious rooms and suites.
Garden Wing rooms have a private balcony and a marble-floored bathroom with a separate shower and bathtub.
The 1 Bedroom Hua Hin Suite may include a furnished balcony, an outdoor jetted bathtub, a sea view and Club Lounge access.
At the pool, guests can lounge on in-pool beds in the shallows, relax in sheltered pavilions or use the Jacuzzi pools.
SPA InterContinental is a spa by the sea that welcomes guests with a refreshing towel, a herbal drink and a mini fruit stick set.
Museo Auto Classica's exhibits are enhanced by artworks, including paintings by National Artists.
All rooms include one-time access to the Vana Nava water park per stay.
Jaras is a beachside restaurant serving modern Thai cuisine inspired by traditional recipes, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
Azure is a beachfront seafood and Italian restaurant led by Executive Chef Mario Caramella.
BluPort Mall is directly adjacent to the resort.
Hua Hin Beach was originally the preserve of the aristocracy, who came to Hua Hin as an escape from Bangkok.

highlights.text: The infinity-edge pool is surrounded by lush greenery and overlooks the ocean.
The 1 Bedroom Beachfront Villa may include an outdoor private pool, an outdoor living area, a sea view and beach access.
Museo Auto Classica at the resort exhibits a curated collection of over 40 classic automobiles.
The Art Botanic Garden is a lush garden designed as a living canvas with artistic touches for the whole family.

considerations.text: The resort is about 245 kilometers from Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi International Airport.
Dogs and cats under 20 kilograms are allowed in Classic Rooms, the 1 Bedroom Beachfront Villa and the 3 Bedroom La Residence.
WhataHotel notes the large resort layout may require walking between facilities.
